import urllib.request
import json
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

def get_entry(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

colec11 = get_entry("Q9BWP8")
ndufs8 = get_entry("O00217")

print("UniProt molWeight:", colec11['sequence']['molWeight'])
seq_c = colec11['sequence']['value']
mw_c = ProteinAnalysis(seq_c).molecular_weight()
print("Calculated MW (Da):", mw_c, "kDa:", mw_c / 1000.0)
